summary: Reviewed backend and completed a public-preview UI pass. Dashboard, all nine navigation routes, category edit request, and responsive shell loaded; goal creation failed with a backend 500 and stopped the dependent Ask/settings checks.

critical.issue: POST returns 500 after inserting the goal because the response includes MongoDB ObjectId _id, which FastAPI cannot JSON serialize.
PATCH returns 200 and writes to MongoDB, but overview returns the hard-coded TRANSACTIONS list; edited category reverts after reload and persistence is not visible to the UI.

integration_issues.issue: Save goal triggers an uncaught Axios 500 runtime error overlay; no success or user-friendly error state is shown.

action_items: Exclude _id or otherwise serialize the inserted goal before returning POST /api/goals.
Read persisted transactions in overview and ensure delete/reset semantics are intentional.
Add frontend error handling for goal creation so API failures do not surface as an uncaught runtime overlay.
Retest Ask Finaura, settings delete, and mobile overflow after fixing the goal flow.
critical_code_review_comments: The API claims Mongo persistence but overview uses static transactions, so category edits cannot persist through the displayed data.
POST /goals violates the MongoDB ObjectId serialization requirement and breaks the primary Goals workflow.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_api_goal attempt; insertion may have succeeded despite the 500 response and should be cleaned up by the developer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard and all nine routes were verified at the public preview. Goal POST serialization failure is confirmed from backend logs. Transaction PATCH returns 200 but overview remains static. Ask, settings delete, and mobile overflow were not completed because the goal runtime overlay interrupted the browser pass.
rca of the issue: create_goal inserts a Motor document and returns the original dict, which now contains _id; FastAPI serialization raises ValueError for ObjectId. update_transaction persists only in finaura_transactions, while overview always returns the module-level TRANSACTIONS constant instead of reading that collection.
